facts.text: I am planning a trip to California.
I am looking for hiking trail recommendations in the Bay Area.
I have a few hiking trails already on my list.
I am thinking about buying a portable hammock to take on my hikes.
I am thinking about buying a bike rack for my new bike.
I want to transport my bike to trailheads more easily.
I just moved to a new apartment.
I have been wanting to explore more of the city on my new bike.
I have been adjusting to the new commute to work.

Cycling along the waterfront is more relaxing for me than driving or taking public transportation.

I have been riding past a pier with great views of the bay and the city skyline.
